integrity: The claim is proved by reconstructing the source affine chart and its six defining equations, then exhaustively checking the symbolic maximal minors of the restricted Jacobian. The infinite statement rests on exact polynomial identities, not finite sampling. A bundled exact-arithmetic verifier reproduces the calculation.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the named six-dimensional Hessenberg–Schubert cell for the principal nilpotent in dimension six with \(h=(3,4,5,6,6,6)\). It does not classify the global singular locus or analytic transverse type. Literature searches cannot exclude an uncatalogued equivalent formulation.
title: Exact singular hyperplane in the \(321654\) regular-nilpotent Hessenberg–Schubert cell
